Command.Description: Create an empty sanctioned MetaPipeline workspace.
Command.Name: new-workspace

Command.Description: Execute a modeled pipeline's serial task chain with compact live progress including B/KB/MB/GB rate.
Command.Name: execute

Command.Description: Execute a modeled pipeline as an orchestration worker boundary over a named pipe; stdout and stderr are diagnostics only; preserves that pipeline context and handles GrantTask and StopPipeline.
Command.Name: execute-worker

Command.Description: Execute exactly one modeled pipeline task by task name or id; diagnostic surface, while orchestration uses execute-worker.
Command.Name: execute-step

Command.Description: Execute one SQL Server transform script with script selection options and compact live progress including B/KB/MB/GB rate.
Command.Name: execute-sqlserver

Command.Description: Create or update the SQL Server MetaPipeline operational DB for diagnostic logs, audit logs, metrics, and failures; it does not store model truth.
Command.Name: create-pipeline-db

Command.Description: Prune old completed RunDiagnosticsLog rows while preserving RunLog and audit lineage.
Command.Name: prune-pipeline-db

Command.Description: Add one Pipeline instance to a MetaPipeline workspace.
Command.Name: add-pipeline

Command.Description: Show a compact MetaPipeline workspace summary.
Command.Name: inspect

Command.Description: Append one executable-backed task instance to the pipeline's serial task chain.
Command.Name: add-executable-step

Command.Description: Append one transform-backed task instance to the pipeline's serial task chain.
Command.Name: add-step
